violation_type.title: Nighttime Requirements - Cot, Bed or Mattress for 18 mos or older (26 TAC §746.3207(3))
violation_type.short_title: Nighttime Requirements - Cot, Bed or Mattress for 18 mos or older
violation_type.typical_finding: A child was observed asleep on the floor during nighttime hours of operation.     NOTE: This was corrected during inspection. Child was provided with a sleeping mat.

finding_variants.text: A child was observed asleep on the floor during nighttime hours of operation.     NOTE: This was corrected during inspection. Child was provided with a sleeping mat.
Two of the children were laying on mats instead of the cots for nighttime care. This was corrected at the inspection when the director changed the mats to the cots for the children to sleep on.
